title: VideoAnalysisResult
description: The result of running OpenCV + MediaPipe pose/speed analysis over one uploaded training/match clip. This is the wire contract between ai-service (producer, POSTs this to the API's callback endpoint) and backend/Api (consumer, persists + broadcasts it). Video is the first and, for this phase, only source of Top Speed and Gait-Balance vitals — the schema is shaped so a future Forge Insole source can populate the same downstream fields without any contract change.

videoId.description: Matches VideoUploads.Id on the API side

fps.description: Effective sampling fps used for pose extraction (~10-15), not the source video's native fps

jointAngleWindows.description: Summarized joint-angle stats over fixed time windows (not raw per-frame data)

symmetryScore.description: 0-100, left/right joint-angle mirror delta, higher = more symmetric

postureStabilityScore.description: 0-100, based on landmark jitter after smoothing

detectionConfidence.description: 0-100. Fraction of sampled frames with a detected person, weighted by landmark visibility — surfaced so a clip where the pose model struggled isn't presented with the same trust as a clean one.

framesSampled.description: Total frames the pipeline sampled from the clip (at TARGET_FPS, not the source frame rate)

framesWithPersonDetected.description: Of framesSampled, how many had a person detected at all

confidence.description: 0-1. Low/zero confidence + method=uncalibrated means topSpeedKmh/avgSpeedKmh are relative estimates only, not absolute — the API must not surface them as real km/h in that case.

gaitBalance.description: Present only when status = Complete. Same 0-100 scale as the existing BodyMapHero Gait-Balance callout — this is the video-derived equivalent of InsoleSummaryDto.AvgBalanceScore.

label.example: Peak speed | Knee valgus on landing

anomalies.description: Left stride 14% shorter than right over a 2s window
